summary: In parallel NFS, metadata and data can be on different servers. When the metadata server restarts, clients may still modify data files, and recovery can lose track of errors a client saw. This document defines how to report errors using LAYOUTRETURN in NFSv4.2.

eli5.summary: A shared storage system has a record keeper and several storage rooms. If the keeper restarts, errors you ran into could be forgotten, so this lets you report them.

questions: how to report errors in pnfs
